title: Ridgelines
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: Minimal personal-website background, wide 16:9 landscape.
Primary request: An original composition of distant layered mountain ridgelines dissolving into a quiet ground-level haze, in a muted sage-and-cream ASCII-halftone aesthetic.
Scene: Low, softly rolling mountain ranges recede across the lower third. The nearest ridge begins at the bottom left and undulates gently toward the bottom center; a distant right ridge meets it through a wide quiet valley. Most of the image is tranquil empty atmospheric sky. No clouds.
Style: Restrained organic landscape made from fine, regularly spaced tiny ASCII-like abstract glyphs, dots and stipples that describe the mountain contours. Soft dusty print quality, tiny digital woven dither, elegant and understated. Glyph texture concentrated on ridges, almost invisible in open space. No actual readable letters or words.
Composition: Wide 16:9. All terrain stays in the bottom 30–35% and outer lower corners. The upper and central 60% must be nearly flat pale sage with calm negative space for website copy, no high contrast detail. Avoid a large central focal point.
Palette: Pale sage and celadon centered around #b8c8b3, warm buttercream atmospheric light, muted dusty teal mountain shadows. Low contrast and narrow tonal range, no black and no bright white.
Mood: Quiet morning, spacious, thoughtful, minimal.
Constraints: Standalone full-bleed raster artwork. No UI, text, logos, frames, borders, cards, watermarks, sun disc, buildings, people or clouds. Preserve flat usable copy space. Not a screenshot or a website mockup.
